intent.outcome: Deliver 6 deferred CLI features from the active backlog, covering brownfield bootstrap and CLI ergonomics.

problem.description: Six backlog items (B-30 through B-35) accumulated across the M-series. They add new CLI surface that users expect: brownfield import flows, session cheat sheets, and step/path ergonomics.

in_scope: B-30: mp brief import --from-file handoff.md — bootstrap brief from existing handoff doc
B-31: mp milestone create --from-handoff — extract phases into milestone stubs
B-32: mp skill context --format markdown — session-tailored cheat sheet from live plan state
B-33: step add --after S4 — ergonomic step ordering helper
B-34: Infer depends_on_steps on decompose from work-package order
B-35: Path grooming/coverage flags (--include grooming, --prioritize coverage, --include coverage-gaps)
out_of_scope: P4/P5 deferred items (B-17 through B-29) — portfolio dashboard, sprint iterations, multi-writer locks
